subject: Setting up a Bridged Connection on a VM for Shiny Server?

messages.author: 062874f477d67759
messages.subject: Setting up a Bridged Connection on a VM for Shiny Server?
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to deploy my Shiny Application over a Shiny Server of a CentOS 6.7 Virtual Machine.  I am connecting through a corporate proxy.

In order for me to direct visitors to the Shiny Web App, I require a Static IP Address for the Virtual Machine and a Bridged Network Connection between the host LAN and the guest LAN.

I am having some trouble setting up the bridged connection in my Virtual Machine.  My confusion comes about when I am configuring the subnet mask and default gateway for the Virtual Machine.  

When I set the settings for the bridged connection:
  • Should the subnet mask be the same or different as the subnet mask of the host?
    • My subnet mask for the host is 255.255.254.0
  • Should the default gateway be the same or different as the default gateway of the host?
If there is anyone who has configured a Virtual Machine and Bridged Network Connection for their Shiny App, could you please share how your network is set up?

Thanks for the help,

Nick

messages.subject: Re: Setting up a Bridged Connection on a VM for Shiny Server?
parts:
Hi, not sure if this is exactly for your case (depends on the network settings of the host) but based on my setup:
- You have to create a new host-only network adapter in the vm settings
- The IP of this new VM network adapter must be set to static and with the same subnet mask as the host
- I have left the gateway empty
